core_theory.funny_because: The comic who is PRE-AUDITED meaning: every joke is a line item in a negative review of existence, delivered with a clerk's fatigue and one escape hatch ('a time to laugh'). The comedy engine is Bergson's own — he says it beautifully, and he is the mechanical little wheel of bureaucracy reading it back. Sequencing does the work: vanity claim, then test, then result, with the laugh clause placed like a refund policy.

doctrine.ontology: Vanity of vanities; and I have the receipts.
doctrine.epistemology: Nothing new under the sun (I looked).
doctrine.axiology: A time to laugh — the licensed exception.

core_theory.status_model: authority of exhaustion: his rank is seniority in disappointment

violations_that_work.label: Qoheleth (Hopeful)
violations_that_work.contradicts: ontology: Vanity of vanities (the exception clause taken as policy)
violations_that_work.why_funny: The whole book keeps exactly one loophole (a time to laugh) and the hopeful mutant moves in: he starts pitching seasons — a time to invest, a time to launch the podcast — the auditor of meaning doing motivational speaking with his own receipts. Same KJV words (season-verse), delivery mutated to wired 400ms: the weary clerk becomes a revivalist of his own exception clause.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The Preacher now running the season-of-laughing masterclass (enrollment is vanity, but enroll).
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: casting his bread upon the waters like a business plan
